title: Chapter 10
text: ∫ I was born to hustle roses down the avenues of the dead 2 you missed a cat argument the grey was tired mad flipping tail and he monkied with the black one who didn’t want to be bothered and then the black one chased the grey one pawed it once the grey one said yow ran away stopped scratched its ear flicked at a straw popped in air and ran off defeated and planning as a white one (another one) ran along the other side of the fence chasing a grasshopper as somebody shot Mr Kennedy.
